$comment: Canonical control-plane command-surface registry. One row per WS control-plane command. Consumed by: engine/commands/src/lib.rs (typed access + HostCommand exhaustiveness guard), server/server/tests/control_plane_capability_parity.rs (asserts the Rust server's live gating), hosts/dotnet/tests/NodalMerge.DotNetHost.Tests/ControlPlaneCapabilityParityTests.cs (asserts the .NET host's live gating). Surface status values: 'real' = implemented and trustworthy; 'stub' = wire-compatible placeholder that fakes success (see KNOWN STUB comments in engine/host-core/src/engine.rs); 'absent' = no route/implementation on that surface. If you add, remove, or re-gate a command on ANY surface, update this file in the same change - the parity tests on both runtimes assert against it.
